verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core product is built around background automations—auto-scheduling tasks, habits, buffers, travel time, calendar sync, and auto-rescheduling of lower-priority events—all running without manual intervention, corroborated by community users describing it as 'staying out of the way' and automatically rearranging their calendars (reclaim-comm-3, reclaim-comm-9, reclaim-comm-10). Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose custom trigger/action automation builder beyond calendar-specific behaviors, and independent reliability data at scale (one community report of a sync feature not working, reclaim-comm-5).
